entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I have a problem with my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so lost with it, I'm not sure what to do.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble, but I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I think it's broken. The numbers it shows are all wrong when I ride. Honestly, it feels like a piece of garbage. I've been so overwhelmed trying to figure it out.
I understand the frustration. Sometimes a quick reset can clear up issues like that. If you have the band nearby, I can walk you through it. It only takes a minute.
Oh, no, I don't think I can do that. I really don't have time for troubleshooting and I'm not good with tech. I just want money back. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.
I understand you'd prefer to return it. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. One moment please.
Okay, I see here the VeloBand was delivered 35 days ago. Let me just confirm our return eligibility...
Is that okay? I tried to look online but the policy was so confusing.

Yes, absolutely. I'm looking at our policy right now, and it states that items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that window, I cannot approve this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried it was going to be a whole thing.

Not a problem at all. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to you. Simply place the sensor back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at any post office. You'll see the full refund in your account 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
